label: FP
reason: The user-provided value is only used in a conditional assignment where it is assigned to bar only if the condition fails. The condition (7*42)-num > 200 evaluates to false (since 7*42=294, 294-106=188 which is not greater than 200), so bar is set to param in the false branch. However, the sink is bar.toCharArray(), which is not vulnerable to XSS because charArray conversion does not produce a reflected HTML string. Moreover, the value is not rendered directly in response content—only converted to character array, which is harmless. Thus, there is no actual XSS risk.

evidence.note: Condition evaluates to false, so param is assigned to bar; however, bar is converted to char array and not rendered in HTML
